fusions.name: Scent Ping
fusions.desc: Sends a ping into the first enemy it meets, dealing 7 resonating damage and leaving it [Marked] for 8 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Run Down
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target and strike it for 16 dark damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Predator's Surge
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Quarry's End
fusions.desc: Against enemies below 50% health, you deal 15% more damage.
